_comment: Template only - never contains real credentials, safe to commit. Copy this file to C:\HikGateway\PayrollController\sage_employee_puller.json and fill in real values there. The real one is gitignored (see .gitignore in this folder) so it can never be committed by accident. Full docs in README_CON.md.

companies._comment: One entry per Sage Company Number - dsn must match a Windows ODBC DSN already configured on this PC (the same one the existing Excel/VBA payroll tooling uses). paypoints are Sage's own PaypointCode values (e.g. 'BKN', 'UADT') - must match what's configured on the matching Sage Payroll Company doctype's Paypoints table in Frappe.
